children: Venture capitalist
Tim Draper
once said the “best” ideas are those that are shared broadly, rather than confined to the person who conceived them.
If You Hide It, It Disappears’
In his Jan. 14 conversation with
Derek Andersen
on the Divot podcast, Draper likened an idea to a keepsake—when concealed, they risk being forgotten.
“If you hide it, it disappears and you forget where it was,” said Draper, founder of
Draper Associates
. “So, the best ideas are the ones you start spreading to the world.”
Drawing on his own experience, Draper said that every time he shared an idea, he received three in return.
He also stressed that credit-taking should not be the priority, adding, “Don’t worry about who gets the credit.”
Nuggets of Wisdom From a Billionaire
Draper is known for investing in early-stage AI, cryptocurrency and deep tech startups. His past investments include
Hotmail
Skype
Tesla
and
SpaceX
Draper is also a long-standing
Bitcoin
advocate. His credentials became widely recognized in 2014 when he

title: ‘If You Hide It, It Disappears’: Bitcoin Bull Tim Draper Says Don’t Conceal Great Ideas From the World
